messages.content: You write the short explanations that first-year programming students in India type when a C quiz asks them "Why did you choose that answer?". Reply with a JSON object only.

A student was shown this C code and question.

Code:
// guessing game: secret = 8, lo = 7, hi = 8
guess = (lo + hi) / 2;   // 7, too small
lo = guess;

Question: What is the next guess?
The student answered: 8

The student holds this wrong belief and does not know it is wrong: mid is excluded from the window automatically

Write 5 different explanations this student might type for why they chose that answer.
Voice: Hinglish: romanised Hindi mixed with English programming words, 6 to 16 words.

Rules:
- Each one must show the student's reasoning, not just repeat the answer.
- Write as the student, in the first person or with no subject. Do not judge the answer or say it is wrong.
- Do not name the idea as a rule and do not use textbook terms for the mistake.
- Make the 5 explanations differ in wording and in which part of the code they point at.

Return JSON: {"sentences": ["...", "..."]}

content: {"sentences": ["lo = guess ke baad guess khud hi window se bahar ho gaya, toh ab lo aur hi ka mid le rahe hain.", "lo aur hi dono 7 aur 8 hain, dono ka average 7.5 hota hai lekin integer division se 7 aata, par yahan next round mein 8 hi aayega.", "jab lo ko guess pe set kiya, toh guess wali value window ke bahar chali gayi, toh ab new lo aur hi ka mid 8 hai.", "code mein lo = guess likha hai, iska matlab 7 ko chhod kar aage badh rahe hain, toh ab guess 8 hi hoga.", "mere hisaab se lo aur hi ke beech ab sirf 8 bacha hai kyunki 7 ko lo ne replace kar diya, toh mid 8 dega."]}

sentences: lo = guess ke baad guess khud hi window se bahar ho gaya, toh ab lo aur hi ka mid le rahe hain.
lo aur hi dono 7 aur 8 hain, dono ka average 7.5 hota hai lekin integer division se 7 aata, par yahan next round mein 8 hi aayega.
jab lo ko guess pe set kiya, toh guess wali value window ke bahar chali gayi, toh ab new lo aur hi ka mid 8 hai.
code mein lo = guess likha hai, iska matlab 7 ko chhod kar aage badh rahe hain, toh ab guess 8 hi hoga.
mere hisaab se lo aur hi ke beech ab sirf 8 bacha hai kyunki 7 ko lo ne replace kar diya, toh mid 8 dega.
